name: personal-brand-website
description: Raghda Medhat Ali's personal website, with a hand-painted hero animation made with ClaudeAnimationBase (p5.js + p5.brush)

scripts.hero: node render.mjs --lite --clip --out=out/hero_master.mp4 && node render.mjs --lite --stills=6.6 --out=out/stills && npm run hero:web
scripts.hero:web: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/hero_master.mp4 -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 27 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an site/assets/hero.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/stills/t6_60.png -vf scale=1280:-1 -q:v 3 site/assets/hero-poster.jpg
